## Summary

Documentation and QA: update README, docs/DEVELOPER.md, RELEASE.md, AGENTS.md for the Steamworks build/QA workflow, and document a manual end-to-end test plan using a real Steam account.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] README, docs/DEVELOPER.md, RELEASE.md, and AGENTS.md updated to document: Steamworks build/QA workflow, steam_appid.txt bootstrap, follow-unlock feature, and browser fallback (doc-update policy).
- [ ] Manual E2E test plan (real Steam account) documented: follow → store page opens → unlock choice → relaunch persistence → browser fallback.
- [ ] Full `npm test` passes and `npm run build` succeeds with all new changes (intake AC7, project quality gate).
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md left to the ship skill's release pipeline (not edited here).

## Minimal Implementation

- Doc edits + manual QA checklist recorded in the test plan / docs.
- Run full suite + build at the end of implementation.

## Dependencies

- F3, F4, F5 (documents their behavior). Parent blocked-by CG-0MSMAD19O0084CAW.

## Deliverables

- Updated docs, manual E2E QA checklist, green suite + build.
data.title: F6: Docs and Steam E2E QA plan
